Download a TAPR data file

txs_get_tapr_file.Rd

Downloads (or returns the cached copy of) a single Texas Academic Performance Reports statewide data file. TEA serves these through its SAS-broker "Advanced Download" interface: one CSV per year, level, and dataset code (e.g. "REF" for campus/district reference information, "STAAR1" for STAAR performance). Use txs_list_downloads() to see the codes available for a year, and txs_get_tapr() for per-campus semantic datasets.

Usage

txs_get_tapr_file(
  year,
  level = c("campus", "district", "region", "state"),
  geography = NULL,
  dataset = NULL,
  data_type = c("advanced", "rates"),
  file_format = c("csv", "txt", "xlsx", "html"),
  cache = TRUE,
  refresh = FALSE,
  output = c("tidy", "wide", "raw"),
  keep_raw = FALSE,
  timeout = 60,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

year

Integer ending year (e.g. 2024 for 2023-24).

level

One of "campus", "district", "region", "state".

geography

Optional. A character vector of campus or district numbers to filter the parsed file to. NULL returns all rows for statewide downloads. For file_format = "html", supply exactly one campus, district, or region identifier.

dataset

Dataset code for data_type = "advanced", e.g. "REF", "STAAR1", "GRAD". Case-insensitive. Required for advanced downloads; see txs_list_downloads().

data_type

"advanced" (the statewide data files: numerators, denominators, and rates) or "rates" (legacy static rates-only files, when TEA publishes them).

file_format

"csv" (statewide files) or "html" (a public TAPR/TPRS report page for one requested geography).

cache

If TRUE, reuse a cached copy when one exists.

refresh

If TRUE, re-download even if cached.

output

"tidy" (long, masking-aware), "wide" (raw with human-readable labels attached), or "raw" (as parsed).

keep_raw

If TRUE, attach the raw parsed frame as attr(out, "raw").

timeout

HTTP timeout in seconds.

verbose

Print progress messages.

Value

A tibble with a txschools attribute carrying source/metadata.
